headline: the life of a launch
body:
1 · mint: anyone can launch a coin on a bonding curve in seconds.
2 · the curve: lately, fewer than ~3 in 100 launches on major launchpads fill it.
3 · migration: the curve fills and liquidity moves to a dex pool.
4 · first 20m: in one launchpad dataset, ~73% of graduates were down 60%+ within 20 min of migrating.
5 · after: whatever's left. a small club.
footer: real-market figures: secondary lifecycle data, approximate
